focus: جلسه هجدهم · نشانه‌های حال کامل (just / already / never)

sentences.en: Have you locked the door?

sentences.fa: در رو قفل کردي؟ کليد بر نداشتم.
sentences.en: Have you locked the door? I haven't taken the key.

sentences.fa: نگران نباش مادرم در رو قفل کرد.
sentences.en: Don't worry my mother locked the door.
Are you sure your father has eaten dinner?
Where have you put my key?
Where did you put my key last night?

sentences.fa: لباست رو بعد شام عوض مي کني؟
sentences.en: Are you changing your clothes after the dinner?

sentences.fa: لباسم رو قبل از شام عوض کردم.
sentences.en: I changed my clothes before dinner.
Why don't you see a doctor?
I saw a doctor yesterday, it was no use.
Are you eating dinner?
I have eaten dinner.
Thank you very much indeed.
How many people did your mother invite?
Why has your mother invited me?

sentences.fa: مي شه اين فيلم رو عوض کني؟ فيلم رو ديدم.
sentences.en: Could you change this film? I have seen it.
What did you buy for your wife last year?
Is it ok if I give it to my wife?
I haven't found anything for her.
Has your wife bought anything for you?
What did your wife buy for you?
Have you memorized the conversation?

sentences.fa: مکالمه رو هفته پيش حفظ کردي؟
sentences.en: Did you memorize the conversation last week?

sentences.fa: چرا از من نمي پرسي؟ مکالمه رو حفظ کردم.
sentences.en: Why don't you ask me? I have memorized the conversation.
Why didn't you ask me last night?
Why haven't you asked me?
My mother has asked everything.
What shall I ask you?
Have you changed your house?

sentences.fa: چرا خونت رو پارسال عوض کردي؟
sentences.en: Why did you change your house last year?

sentences.fa: چند مدت قبل خونه ات رو عوض کردي؟
sentences.en: How long ago did you change your house?
What shall I do? My mother has overslept.
Have you called your mother?

sentences.fa: ده دقيقه قبل زنگ زدم، منتظرشم.
sentences.en: I called her 10 minutes ago, I am waiting for her.

sentences.fa: شروع کنيم؟ شروع کنيم. سؤالي داري؟ سؤالي ندارم. شروع کنيم.
sentences.en: Shall we start? Let's start, have you got any question? I haven't got question, let's start.
